notes: SVGs were authored directly as code (deterministic vector primitives).
PNGs were rendered with PIL (Pillow) using the same palette tokens declared in web/acquirer/assets/styles.css.
All assets use the existing site palette; no third-party fonts or copyrighted glyphs were embedded.

Per-asset prompts below summarize the design intent; the canvas-design skill provided the philosophy ('Geometric Silence / Signal Topology'), and the visuals were executed with hand-coded primitives so each output is XML-valid and pixel-deterministic.

assets.prompt: Sapphire OS wordmark for light backgrounds. Octahedral monogram (sapphire cross-section: rhombus + facet + cross-hairs + center node) followed by a sans-serif wordmark. Wordmark uses dark sapphire #0b1220 with the OS suffix in electric blue #1565C0 to imply duality without breaking the palette.
256x64 raster export of logo.svg, rendered with Pillow primitives.
Same construction as logo.svg, recolored for the dark sapphire background. Wordmark in off-white #e6ecff with the OS suffix in #8edcff.
32x32 monogram-only mark on a 6px-radius rounded square, deep sapphire base with #8edcff stroke and a translucent #6da5ff facet fill.
Multi-resolution ICO container (32x32 + 16x16) generated from the favicon design with Pillow.

1200x630 share-preview composition. Sapphire OS logo top-left, headline 'Sapphire OS / Multi-modal Intelligence Platform' centered-left in display weight (second line in #8edcff). Subhead 'Built for acquirers, ready for production diligence.' Five thin signal curves converge from the left edge into a central octahedral correlation hub with concentric ambient rings. Subtle 40px grid; deep sapphire #0b1220 base.
